fix.why: Participants who are not assigned to a custom category still need category limits and settings to apply to them.
fix.outcome: Every participant is covered by category settings and limits, including those left without a category or moved out of a deleted one.

reason: EP-14938 only states the request for a default category; no past problem is stated, and 'do not have to chase uncategorised profiles' is invented backstory.

fix.detail: The apps pick US English from the phone’s locale, with US spellings such as “Favorites”. The “Matchmaking information” section on public profiles is now called “Profile Information”.
fix.outcome: App users whose phones are set to US English see US spelling, and everyone sees a clearer label on profiles.

reason: Detail said Android network security settings were 'tightened'; EP network_security_config story adds a config so app requests can be inspected for debugging (wrong direction, internal). US English follows phone locale, not location (EP-12277).

fix.why: Multilingual support was a main requirement for upcoming events, and in-app pages opened in English whatever language the phone and app used.
fix.outcome: App users can use the app in Arabic, and profile, floor plan and basket pages open in their app language when the event offers it.

reason: EP-20409 value names one client's planned events, not 'many events'; outcome 'the whole app in their own language' overstates: only listed webviews, and only when the event has the language (EP-23090).

fix.why: Categories sometimes differ by only one or two settings, yet organisers had to go through every option again to create a new one.
fix.outcome: Organisers set up new categories with less effort by cloning an existing one and changing only the settings that differ.

reason: EP-23224 says 'sometimes' only 1 or 2 settings vary (not 'often'); 'faster' unsupported, value says 'minimize efforts'.

fix.benefit: Discounts work in the new basket, invoice payment has its own step, and a direct link adds a session to the basket.
fix.detail: Discounts were implemented in the new basket, the invoice payment logic was updated, and the session “add to basket” link adds a session to the basket directly when opened.
fix.why: The new basket needed the discount rules of the previous basket, and the Add to basket link on session pages had to add the session directly when opened.
fix.outcome: Buyers get the discounts they are due on tickets and sessions, and organisers can share a link that adds a session straight to the basket.

reason: 'More reliably'/'improved' overstates: EP-26659 ports old discount logic to the new basket; EP-26652 makes an existing link work (sessions did not 'gain' it); link adds to basket, not 'straight to paying'.

fix.why: Organisers need to charge different prices for the same ticket depending on when people buy it.

reason: Implied why claimed organisers 'often' do this; no source states frequency (EP-26895).

fix.why: Organisers needed to sell different sets of tickets depending on the country a registrant selects, with the option to let other combinations register free rather than be stopped.

reason: EP-37154 is one client's request, not 'some' organisers; reworded to the stated need.

fix.outcome: Buyers are charged the VAT that applies to their situation, and organisers can turn the VAT rules off if they do not need them.

reason: 'When they manage tax another way' is an invented reason; EP-32621 only states a Disable VAT rules setting.

fix.detail: Custom block pages can be shown only to logged-out users; custom blocks can link to the app sign-in page and to other app pages; the Gilroy font can be chosen for headings and text; and the app builder preview now shows the real app view, without a Download all button the apps do not show.

reason: Detail said 'forms are shown in an embedded frame' and 'Download all can be hidden on custom documents blocks'; EP-35827 renders the app builder preview in an iframe, EP-32270 hides Download all in the preview only because the apps lack it.

fix.outcome: Participants upgrade from their profile and pay only the difference, and can see their current category on the dashboard.

reason: 'Always see' overstates: EP-26634 shows the category only when the form has a category field.

fix.outcome: Registrants are told when a number is in the wrong format, and organisers get phone numbers in a usable format.

reason: EP-44198 is summary only; 'as they enter it' (live validation timing) is not stated.

fix.why: Organisers and participants needed an offline way to pay when registering.

reason: 'Instead of card payment only' is wrong: PayPal and Parampos were already available; EP-34905 value states only an offline payment option.

fix.benefit: Prevent participant categories being changed by mistake in the admin panel.
fix.why: Organisers asked for a hard block on accidental participant category changes, beyond the existing warning, especially for participants imported with categories already assigned.
fix.outcome: Participants keep the category they were registered or imported with, as it cannot be changed by mistake in the admin panel.

reason: 'Once registration is set up' not in EP-45795; 'a warning alone did not stop them' and 'knock-on effects' are invented; source says a warning existed and a hard restriction was requested.

fix.outcome: Registrants see only the tickets that apply to where they are from, and organisers can move to the new ticketing and keep showing tickets by country.

reason: 'Country pricing' is wrong: EP-33039 is visibility by country, not pricing.

fix.benefit: Open sessions from links, see tidier profiles and get loading feedback on the Tickets page.
fix.detail: Deep links open sessions directly in the app. The About me section on delegate profiles on iOS is hidden when empty, and the Tickets page shows a loading spinner while updating.

reason: Tickets spinner story is iOS (ai outcome claims both, conflicting), so the platform claim is dropped; hiding an empty About me is not 'feedback' (EP-47476).

fix.benefit: Brand the registration welcome, confirmation and sold-out pages for participants and buyers from the admin panel.

reason: 'Without custom code' unsupported: confirmation pages explicitly support custom scripts (Stories 3, 4, 21).

fix.outcome: Registrants finish free bookings in one step and keep their place when reading the terms, and organisers find a payer's record by searching instead of scrolling.

reason: 'Find any payment record in seconds' is an unsupported speed claim; EP-54690 only replaces scrolling with search.

fix.benefit: An event app’s custom typeface now appears consistently across every Android screen.
fix.detail: An event app’s custom font, previously used only on the My Account and Event Info screens, now covers all remaining Android screens for a consistent look, and the app shows ExpoPlatform branding.

reason: 'Set in the app builder' and organisers 'applying' a typeface are not in EP-56372: it rolled one app's font out to the remaining Android layouts.
